parts.premise: When it comes to how much time a parent should allocate for a child’s homework, the National Education Association and the National Parent Teacher Association recommend 10 minutes for each grade level. For example, a first grader would be given 10 minutes of homework, a fifth grader would get 50 minutes and an eighth grader would receive 80 minutes.
parts.hypothesis: First graders were doing 28 minutes of homework.
